payload.title: The module manager is stored twice and the copies never meet: Assign Manager writes only tenant_modules.managerId, which no token or access decision reads, while tokens and invites use user_module_assignments; the assignment permissions JSON and the assignUserToModule/removeUserFromModule mutations have no reader or caller
evidence: apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant.service.ts:578-580 (Assign Manager writes managerId only and creates no user_module_assignments row)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/entities/tenant-module.entity.ts:102-108 (managerId mapped and exposed on GraphQL; only tenant.service.ts:579 and :609 touch it)

apps/auth-service/src/modules/authentication/services/token.service.ts:563-574 (the modules claim is built from assignments only, so a designated manager without an assignment row gets no claim for the module)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/authentication/entities/user-module-assignment.entity.ts:81-83 (permissions JSON exposed on GraphQL; its only reader hasPermission at :148-151 has no caller)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/resolvers/tenant-admin.resolver.ts:114-138 (assignUserToModule and removeUserFromModule; no operation in web, aquamobil or e2e calls them)
payload.rule_violated: Repo SSOT rule (one owner per fact) and plan §2: the per-module role lives only in user_module_assignments and is the only source of the moduleAccess claim.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-06, release R3.
